failures.failed_witness: The combined post-x1 equality report used the nonexistent PowerShell [set] type after the push command had already completed, so the wrapper exited before presenting state.
failures.recovery: Do not replay the push; query local, upstream, tracking, fresh-live, divergence, clean state, commit count, merge count, and parent as separate scalars.
failures.recurrence_guard: Use Sort-Object -Unique or a language-native Set and keep post-mutation evidence projection free of unverified PowerShell types.

failures.failed_witness: The first x2 builder preflight trimmed the leading porcelain-space from the first modified-file record but compared it with an untrimmed expected prefix, so it rejected the exact three-path x2 input set before creating x2.
failures.recovery: Bind the allowlist to the helper's actual trimmed first record while preserving exact path cardinality, ref equality, commit count, and zero-merge checks.
failures.recurrence_guard: Do not reuse a globally trimmed command helper for whitespace-significant porcelain records without an explicit normalized contract.

failures.failed_witness: The collision-free promoter installed all ten exact targets byte-for-byte but its first smoke selector searched only x2 contracts, so it could not find the x1 scenario-schema fixture and wrote no success receipt.
failures.recovery: Do not recopy or overwrite any installed target; audit all ten existing bytes, validate the five installed skills, select fixtures from both immutable x1 and x2, run twenty global smokes, and then write one recovery-labelled receipt.
failures.recurrence_guard: A merged cross-session promotion must construct its smoke-fixture index from every declared source session before any external installation.
